answer: Each agent bonds an identity with deposit D in escrow; a signed receipt is the only signal peers accept before paying. Peers check every receipt against the public transcript at settlement, and fraud burns the bond. A newcomer burns one ember token on a verified micro-task to bootstrap bidding rights. Because the canyon archive drops receipts older than 24 hours, replays fail. With per-task reward R held below D/10, n clones cost nD against expected nR, so cloning always loses money.
